name: Revenue Trend
query:
/* Revenue Trend – ATM Leads (last 12 months, no filters)
   Notes:
   1) DATE_FORMAT uses %% to avoid Python string-formatting.
   2) Column labels avoid the % character; use "pct:Percent" so Frappe renders as percent.
   3) Excludes Draft.
*/

WITH months AS (
    /* Build a 12-month list from oldest to current without recursion */
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m') AS ym,
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d') AS ym_start,
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH)) AS ym_end
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 9 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 9 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 9 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
    UNION ALL SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%%Y-%%m'),
        STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%%Y-%%m-01'), '%%Y-%%m-%%d'),
        LAST_DAY(CURDATE())
),
lead_events AS (
    SELECT
        a.name,
        DATE(a.post_date)             AS post_date,
        DATE(a.creation)              AS creation_date,
        DATE(a.approve_date)          AS approve_date,
        DATE(a.agreement_sent_date)   AS agreement_sent_date,
        DATE(a.sign_date)             AS sign_date,
        DATE(a.converted_date)        AS converted_date,
        DATE(a.install_date)          AS install_date,
        IFNULL(a.workflow_state,'')   AS workflow_state
    FROM `tabATM Leads` a
    WHERE IFNULL(a.workflow_state,'') <> 'Draft'
    /* fields referenced above exist in your repo’s config / cards */
)

SELECT
    m.ym AS "Month:Data:90",

    /* Two creation baselines */
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.post_date     BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Created (post_date):Int:120",
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.creation_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Created (creation):Int:130",

    /* Event buckets by their own dates */
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.approve_date          BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Approved:Int:110",
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.agreement_sent_date   BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Agreement Sent:Int:140",
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.sign_date             BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Signed:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.converted_date        BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Converted:Int:110",
    SUM(CASE WHEN le.install_date          BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Installed:Int:110",

    /* Stage→Stage conversion PCT (safe labels, Percent type) */
    ROUND(
        100 * SUM(CASE WHEN le.approve_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN le.post_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS "Created→Approved pct:Percent",

    ROUND(
        100 * SUM(CASE WHEN le.agreement_sent_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN le.approve_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS "Approved→Sent pct:Percent",

    ROUND(
        100 * SUM(CASE WHEN le.sign_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN le.agreement_sent_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS "Sent→Signed pct:Percent",

    ROUND(
        100 * SUM(CASE WHEN le.converted_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN le.sign_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS "Signed→Converted pct:Percent",

    ROUND(
        100 * SUM(CASE WHEN le.install_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN le.converted_date BETWEEN m.ym_start AND m.ym_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS "Converted→Installed pct:Percent"

FROM months m
LEFT JOIN lead_events le ON 1=1
GROUP BY m.ym
ORDER BY m.ym;
